actionHint.intake: Create the workspace project, take the Trello ticket, collect the input spec.

actionHint.build: Domain agents work task by task on their own branch, merged one by one through the test gate.
actionHint.verify: An agent checks the product against 100% of the spec; gaps become fix tasks and are built again.
actionHint.report: Report queue, verification and git; the ticket moves to waiting for deploy.
actionHint.deploy: Deploy the merged build (the project needs deploy settings).

err.name: Enter a step name (≤ 80 characters).
err.agent_key: Pick an agent for the "Custom agent" action.
err.gate_group: Enter the approving group key (e.g. dlc-editor).
err.reject_to: Only available with an approval gate.
err.keyTaken: This key already exists — choose another.
err.conflict: Someone else just edited this step — close and reopen to load the latest.

runDetail.subtitle: Each step of the run: who did what and why it stopped.

kindHint.notify: A Notification step posts to each recipient's bell (and email if chosen). With no recipients the step still finishes and records a warning in its result.
kindHint.wait_until: A Wait-until step holds the run until the due time, then continues on its own. If the contract has no such date the step stops for someone to decide.

runDetail.rerunBy: This run was rerun as a new run.

drawer.loadFail: Could not load this step's log. Try again in a few minutes.
drawer.empty: Nothing to show for this step yet.

ctl.reasonHint: Pick a reason to continue — it is recorded on the timeline.

stop.title: Stop this run?
stop.effect: The run stops now: unfinished steps will not run and tasks waiting for people are closed. This cannot be undone; to try again, rerun the whole run.

rerun.title: Rerun the whole run?
rerun.effect: Creates a new run from the first step with the same process and inputs. This run is kept for comparison.

reopen.title: Reopen the contract's process?
reopen.effect: The contract is unlocked for editing and the approval process runs again when it is sent for approval. This run is kept for comparison.
reopen.platformReasonHint: You are reopening on behalf of this company. Enter a reason (up to 500 characters) — the reason and your name are recorded in the contract history.

rerun-step.title: Rerun step “{{name}}”?
rerun-step.effect: This step runs again within the same run; its earlier results are kept as history.

rerun-from-if.title: Re-run from the If step?
rerun-from-if.effect: The record's data changed. The run re-reads the current values at the If step and continues from there; earlier steps stay as they are.
rerun-from-if.done: Re-run from the If step started

runDetail.factsChanged: Needs attention · data changed after the branch
runDetail.missingFact: {{keys}} is missing — fill it in on the contract, then Retry

err.packBound: This contract has finished. To approve again, open the contract and press “Reopen process”.
err.state: The run's state has changed, so this action no longer applies. Reload the page and try again.
err.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this. Ask a platform admin or your company admin.
err.notFound: Run not found (it may have been deleted). Go back to the process list.
err.generic: Could not complete this. Check your connection and try again.

byCompany.title: Processes
byCompany.subtitle: Each company's own processes, created from a blank diagram.
byCompany.noApproval: {{company}} has Contract Book on but no approval process in use — staff cannot send contracts for approval yet.
byCompany.hint: Click a process name to open its diagram. A new process stays a Draft until you click "Apply to company".
byCompany.deleteBody: This process is still a draft: not applied to the company and never run. Deleting cannot be undone.

flow.toolOff: «{{name}}» is not enabled for your company — turn it on in the Company page, then save again.

esign.title: E-sign settings
esign.packOff: This company has not turned on E-sign — turn it on under Company › Apps.
esign.packOffPlatform: A platform admin account cannot load the company's e-sign options. Set signers and signing method in the editor while signed in as a company user.
esign.unavailable: Could not load e-sign options. Open the company copy to edit this.
esign.disabled: E-sign is not enabled for this company. Enable it in {{path:flow}}.

err.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: This provider is not enabled for the company.
err.SIGNER_NOT_IN_TENANT: The signer is not in this company.
err.NO_SIGNER: This group has no usable signer.
err.NO_SIGNER_SELECTED: no signer yet. Pick a person or a department to sign, then save again
err.DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE: Could not check the directory, try again later.

esign.signChooses: How to sign: the signer chooses when signing

flow.moduleNote: The provider, signers and other settings of this step come from the app settings. Open Advanced to tweak details.

notify.toGroupPh: Do not send to a department
notify.title: Title

flow.moreRight: More steps to the right — drag to see
flow.dragHint: Drag into the diagram: drop on empty space to add, on an arrow to insert in between.
flow.scheduleDaysRange: Enter a number of days from {{min}} to {{max}}.

testRun.title: Test run · {{name}}
testRun.banner: Test run: no real contract is created, no notification is sent, no signature is recorded. You play each approver.
testRun.willAssign: In a real run this goes to: {{who}}
testRun.noOne: In a real run nobody would receive this step — choose an approver in the step.
testRun.hint: The test uses the departments, members and steps of the draft you have open. After editing, run again from the start.

outline.doneSub: Rejected at any step ⇒ Rejected · Sent back ⇒ Draft, resubmit to start over
outline.approveNote: The approver has 3 buttons: Approve · Send back · Reject. No need to draw an extra End step.
outline.esignSummary: Send the contract for signing and wait until it is signed
outline.blocked: {{n}} item(s) still need fixing — fix the steps marked “Needs fixing” before saving and applying.
outline.blockedSteps: ⚠ {{n}} step(s) need attention — click a step to open it:
outline.unsupported: This process was built in the old format, so it is view-only here. Processes are authored by the platform admin — contact them for changes (or create a new process from a blank diagram).

flow.ifHint: If true go to “Then”, otherwise “Otherwise” (empty = next step).

warn.reject: “{{name}}”: Reject continues to a later step — are you sure?
warn.ret: “{{name}}”: Return continues to a later step — are you sure?

bridge.missing: Step “{{to}}” needs “{{key}}” but the previous step does not provide it
bridge.chipFull: Step «{{to}}» needs «{{keys}}» — the previous step does not have it
bridge.none: No suggestion yet. Ask the platform admin to add a “Prepare data” step.

finish.name: Name
finish.pick: Choose the outcome for the contract.
finish.pickGeneric: Choose the outcome when the process finishes.

err.tooManySteps: A process has at most 20 steps. Merge some.
err.noFinish: Add a Finish step at the end of every branch.
err.nextStepInvalid: The join step must come after the current step.
err.sourceOwner: Only company copies have a source.
err.eventUnknown: Pick one of the app's events.
err.outcomeUnknown: Choose an outcome for the Finish step.
err.whenInvalid: The condition uses a field or value that does not fit this event.
err.invalid: The process is not valid. Open each step with an error.

flow.toolNote: This step runs a system feature. Details are under “Advanced”.
flow.toolNoteCompany: This step runs a system feature; its content is preset by the platform.
